story_type: ten people in the water beside a boat sinking bow up, rescue swimmer moves them to a Good Samaritan's cruiser
hook: Ten people. One sinking boat. 250 feet of water below.
narration: Ten people were in the water, and their boat was going down beside them.
It was a thirty foot boat in Grand Traverse Bay, off Traverse City, Michigan.
A Good Samaritan's cruiser was right alongside them.
A Coast Guard rescue swimmer went into the water with them.
Rescue swimmers often come in from behind, because a panicking swimmer can pull a rescuer under.
One by one, he helped them up onto the cruiser's stern.
[short pause] Behind them, their boat kept sliding lower.
outcome: All ten made it onto the Good Samaritan's boat, and theirs sank in about two hundred fifty feet of water.
title: 10 people beside a sinking boat
description:
On June 19, 2020, a Coast Guard rescue swimmer helped 10 people from a sinking 30-foot boat onto a Good Samaritan's vessel in Grand Traverse Bay near Traverse City, Michigan. The boat sank in about 250 feet of water.
